Nina: Kickoff for SatelliteCloud partnership. Scope: one live webinar, short "benchmarks-as-claims" post, and co-authored quickstart. KPI: 400 signups, 100 MQLs in 6 weeks.
Omar: Proposed webinar slots: Tue May 25 10am PT or Thu May 27 11am PT. Which do we want to offer?
Leah: Thu 27 best for sales coverage. Also want a "Request sandbox" CTA on landing page.
Marco: Sandbox provision needs infra lead time. Requesting a 3-node demo cluster; tagging infra now.
Nina: Lead routing rules: 1) registrants -> queue/satellite-launch; 2) if employees>1000 OR ARR_est>1.5M -> route to AE; else -> SDR nurture.
Omar: Tracking: include utm_partner=satellite and hidden field partner_id=satellite_2026. Use single-field email form to maximize conversions.
LeadsBot: Zap test ok. Sample payload: {"email":"alex@toolsco.com","company":"ToolsCo","employees":120,"utm_partner":"satellite"} sent to https://hooks.redwood.ai/partners.
Leah: Content needs: hero social card, 2 PNG charts (latency vs cost), 1 slide deck. I'll draft copy by Wed COB.
Nina: Action items: Leah -> draft copy + charts by Wed. Omar -> landing page + reg link by Thu. Marco -> open infra ticket for sandbox. I'll request $2k paid social from growth.
Marco: Infra ticket opened: DEMO-4123 (comms sent to eng-infra). ETA 5 business days.
Omar: Post-webinar nurture: 4-email sequence with benchmark highlights, sandbox invite, case study, last-chance demo.
Nina: Great. We'll reconvene Mon for status. Thanks all :tada:
